items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: He took the band to the White House with Jimmy Carter.

ctx.x: Rae Carter. C-A-R-T-E-R. From the Sweethearts of Rhythm. Remember that band? All girl band, right. And they were great. Everybody drifted into Charleston and she happened to be in Charleston. And then they’d play [trumpet interlude, “Tenderly”]. They played like that, breathing was controlled. I don’t know why I paid attention to that, but I paid attention to it. I’m standing in the doorway at the YMCA [humms]. I don’t know why that got my attention. Something in me wanted to be the way she was, sitting in that…
Okay. You said that this morning. You said it’s about songs, and it makes me think that you heard that song and it had that impression on you right back then, because it’s about songs.
